allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Libas Consumer Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 24, 2026, titled "Vacated Non-Bailable Warrant against Mr. Riyaz Ganji, Promoter and Director of the Company".

allot.subject: Action(s) taken or orders passed
allot.text: Libas Consumer Products Limited has informed the Exchange about orders passed by the Bombay High Court vacating non-bailable warrant issued against Mr. Riyaz Ganji.
